steps: During the Promotion Period (through September 30, 2026), join HawaiiUSA by opening a new Prime Share (Savings) account (minimum opening deposit $5).
Open a new eLife or Kasasa Cash Back Checking account (minimum opening deposit $20) and enroll in Digital Banking.
Once qualifications are verified, the first $50 bonus is deposited into your rewards checking account within 60 days.
Within the first two full calendar months after opening, set up direct deposits totaling $1,500 via ACH into the checking account within one monthly calendar period.
After verification, the second $50 bonus is deposited into your rewards checking account within 60 days.
